close_reason: implemented check_extensions: leaf whitelist + CA guard, intermediate whitelist + BasicConstraints+KeyUsage required check
description:
Implement check_extensions() in pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs (currently todo!() at line 335). This is the core of the simplicity gate.

BLOCKED BY: PKIX-cfh API fixes (specifically the SignatureVerifier and TrustAnchor changes).

Leaf cert path (is_leaf=true):
  1. Walk cert.tbs_certificate.extensions (an Option<Extensions>, i.e., Option<Vec<Extension>>)
  2. For each Extension: if ext.extn_id not in ALLOWED_LEAF_EXTENSIONS → Error::UnexpectedExtension { index }
     (applies to BOTH critical and non-critical — the simplicity contract rejects everything unknown)
  3. If BasicConstraints extension is present: parse it and check cA field.
     If cA=TRUE → Error::LeafIsCA (the leaf is a CA cert, not an end-entity)
     If cA=FALSE or absent → fine

Intermediate path (is_leaf=false):
  1. Walk extensions; any OID not in ALLOWED_INTERMEDIATE_EXTENSIONS → Error::UnexpectedExtension { index }
  2. Check BasicConstraints is present and cA=TRUE:
     Absent or cA=FALSE → Error::MissingRequiredExtension { index }
  3. Check KeyUsage is present and keyCertSign bit is set:
     Absent or bit not set → Error::MissingRequiredExtension { index }
     (pkix-chain-simple always requires these; it does not honour enforce_key_usage=false)

x509-cert extension access: cert.tbs_certificate.extensions returns Option<&Extensions>.
Use x509_cert::ext::pkix::BasicConstraints and x509_cert::ext::pkix::KeyUsage decoded from the raw Extension.extn_value bytes.
